reuse.why: Extends the existing getFillableCategories selection and sits next to hasSavedTemplates, so setZero and the average actions pick the rule up for free; copyPreviousMonth's separate inline filter is extended rather than folded into the shared selection.

duplication.why: The tag test is a single isFixedGroup predicate; only the notes join and the predicate call appear twice because the tree already has two selection paths (getBudgetData/copyPreviousMonth and getFillableCategories).

placement.why: The predicate and query changes live in budget/actions.ts beside the existing category-selection helpers.

scope.why: Only the selection query, predicate, copyPreviousMonth filter and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small, named predicate with a clear comment; a maintainer still has to remember the copyPreviousMonth filter is separate from getFillableCategories.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Month-wide actions keep using getFillableCategories; copyPreviousMonth's own filter predates the change.

disguised_duplication.where: The rule is defined once in isFixedGroup; the second call site is an open, identical call in copyPreviousMonth's existing filter.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup in actions.ts defines the rule and is applied by both month-wide selection paths (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth); the call is made in two places because those paths were already separate.
